age.evidence: Adult male and female C57BL/6J mice (8-12 weeks old) were obtained from Charles River Laboratories (UK)

sex.evidence: Adult male and female C57BL/6J mice (8-12 weeks old)

dosing.doses_raw: we selected doses of 0.3 mg/kg and 1 mg/kg of psilocybin
dosing.evidence: they received a single intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection of psilocybin (1 mg/kg) or saline control ... Psilocybin (COMP360...) was dissolved in saline. One additional experiment used repeated dosing: 'Psilocybin was injected every 7 days for 3 weeks' (0.3 mg/kg on days 15, 22, 29).
gabapentin (50 mg/kg i.p.) was administered during the peak anti-nociceptive effect of psilocybin ... Gabapentin was purchased from Sigma and was dissolved in saline.
we therefore preinjected male mice with the 5-HT2AR antagonist volinanserin (0.032mg/kg i.p.) ... followed 30 mins later by psilocybin (1 mg/kg i.p.)

group_housing.evidence: Animals were group-housed in individually ventilated cages (maximum of five per cage)

assays.assay_description: After i.p. psilocybin (0.3 or 1 mg/kg) or saline, mice placed in individual Plexiglas chambers and video-recorded; head twitches manually counted over 30 min. Includes volinanserin (0.032 mg/kg) pretreatment arm. Male and female SNI mice.

application_type.evidence: they received a single intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection of psilocybin (1 mg/kg) or saline control

setup_habituation.evidence: After the drug or saline was administered, the mice were placed in individual Plexiglas chambers and movement recorded using a digital camera.

setup_restrain.evidence: mice were placed in individual Plexiglas chambers and movement recorded

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in the Plexiglas recording chamber (standard testing chamber).

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the Plexiglas recording chamber (standard testing chamber).

time_to_assay.evidence: After the drug or saline was administered, the mice were placed in individual Plexiglas chambers ... The number of head twitches was counted over a 30 min period.

sample_size.evidence: Fig 1B: psilocybin (male mice, n=6; female mice, n=5) or saline control (male mice, n=6; female mice, n=5); Fig 2B: psilocybin (0.3 mg/kg) (n=6) or saline control (n=6); Fig 1J: n=6/6 mice

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (1 mg/kg and 0.3 mg/kg) increased head twitches vs saline in male and female SNI mice, confirming CNS exposure. Volinanserin pretreatment blocked the psilocybin-induced HTR.
outcomes.statistics: Fig 1B: P < 0.001 unpaired independent sample t-test; Fig 2B: P=0.001 unpaired independent sample t-test; Fig 1J: P < 0.001 unpaired independent sample t-test
outcomes.evidence: An increase in HTR was observed in the psilocybin treatment groups compared to saline control both in male and in female mice (Fig 1 B) ... Volinanserin pretreatment blocked the HTR (Fig 1 J)

B1_num_measures.evidence: The number of head twitches was counted over a 30 min period.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total count over 30 min; no within-session time course reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR is excluded from ethological behaviours per rubric.

B5_social.evidence: mice were placed in individual Plexiglas chambers

B6_cognitive.evidence: Drug-induced reflexive response; no learning required.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: The videos for each mouse were subsequently analyzed to count the number of head twitches

E2_shelter.evidence: No shelter described in Plexiglas chamber.

E7_social_context.evidence: mice were placed in individual Plexiglas chambers

D1_continuity.evidence: The number of head twitches was counted over a 30 min period.

D3_recording_days.evidence: HTR recorded once per animal after injection.

D4_baseline.evidence: After the drug or saline was administered ... no pre-drug HTR recording.

D5_followup.evidence: HTR measured only acutely after injection.

assays.assay_name: Von Frey filament test (static mechanical sensitivity)
assays.assay_description: Up-down method with calibrated von Frey filaments on the injured hind paw; mice in Plexiglas chambers on elevated grid after ≥1 h habituation. Tested at baseline and repeatedly after SNI, across single psilocybin (0.3/1 mg/kg), acute time course (30 min–24 h), repeated weekly 0.3 mg/kg, pre-emptive psilocybin, volinanserin pretreatment, sham vs SNI, and psilocybin+gabapentin experiments.

application_type.evidence: single intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection of psilocybin (1 mg/kg); gabapentin (50 mg/kg i.p.); volinanserin (0.032mg/kg i.p.)

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were placed in Plexiglas chambers, located on an elevated grid, and allowed to habituate for at least 1h.

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice were placed in Plexiglas chambers, located on an elevated grid; no restraint described.

food_restriction.evidence: No food in the testing chamber (standard apparatus).

water_restriction.evidence: No water in the testing chamber (standard apparatus).

time_to_assay.evidence: Behavioural measures taken at several time points after injections (30 min, 1h, 2h, 4h, 8, 12h and 24h) ... effect lasted up to day 28 after injection (test day 45)

sample_size.evidence: Fig1C male n=8/8, female n=8/8; Fig1F n=6/6; Fig1H n=5/5; Fig1K n=12/12; Fig2C n=10/9; Fig2G n=5/5; Fig3B n=6/6; Fig3D n=8/8

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin 1 mg/kg reduced mechanical hypersensitivity in male (to day 28 post-injection) and female (one week) SNI mice, beginning 2 h post-injection; 0.3 mg/kg also reduced it and repeated weekly dosing amplified/prolonged the effect. Volinanserin substantially reduced the effect; pre-emptive psilocybin did not prevent hypersensitivity; psilocybin enhanced gabapentin analgesia acutely and when gabapentin was given at day 55.
outcomes.evidence: Mechanical hypersensitivity was reduced in male (%MPE=25.5) and female (%MPE=27) mice treated with psilocybin and in male mice the effect lasted up to day 28 after injection (test day 45) (Fig 1 C). This effect lasted one week in female (test day 21).

B1_num_measures.evidence: The data were expressed as log of the mean of 50% pain threshold ± SEM.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Time course (30 min–24 h) consists of separate test sessions, i.e., between-session comparison, not within-session dynamics.

B4_ethological.evidence: Stimulus-evoked withdrawal threshold, not natural repertoire behaviour.

B5_social.evidence: Mice tested individually in Plexiglas chambers.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: mechanical sensitivity threshold was determined using the up-down-method

E1_environment_type.evidence: Plexiglas chambers, located on an elevated grid

D1_continuity.evidence: Behavioural tests were performed before (baseline) and after SNI surgery until the end of experiments.

D2_session_duration.evidence: Test session duration not explicitly stated (only ≥1 h habituation).

D3_recording_days.evidence: Static mechanical threshold ... before (BS, Baseline) and after SNI surgery (D1 to D85); D1 to D45; daily until Day 36

D4_baseline.evidence: Static mechanical threshold of mice assessed ... before (Bs, baseline) and after SNI surgery

D5_followup.evidence: in male mice the effect lasted up to day 28 after injection (test day 45)

assays.assay_description: Light paintbrush stroking of injured hind paw (heel to toe), responses scored 0–3, three stimulations ≥3 min apart averaged; Plexiglas chambers on elevated grid with ≥1 h habituation. Baseline and post-SNI testing after psilocybin 1 mg/kg (Fig 1D) or 0.3 mg/kg (Fig 2D), male mice.

application_type.evidence: single intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection of psilocybin (1 mg/kg) ... psilocybin (0.3 mg/kg)

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were placed in Plexiglas chambers located on an elevated grid, and allowed to habituate for at least 1h.

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice were placed in Plexiglas chambers located on an elevated grid; no restraint described.

food_restriction.evidence: No food in the testing chamber (standard apparatus).

water_restriction.evidence: No water in the testing chamber (standard apparatus).

time_to_assay.evidence: Brush-evoked dynamic hypersensitivity before (Bs) and after SNI surgery ... D14 to D45; D13 to D65 (psilocybin injected day 12–15); exact minutes post-injection not stated.

outcomes.summary: Preliminary data indicate psilocybin (1 mg/kg and 0.3 mg/kg) reduced brush-evoked dynamic hypersensitivity scores in male SNI mice vs saline.
outcomes.statistics: Fig1D: factor 'treatment' D14 to D45: F=6.5, P=0.034; Fig2D: factor 'treatment' D13 to D65: F=7.2, P=0.025
outcomes.evidence: In male mice, preliminary data also indicate that psilocybin (1 mg/kg) was also able to reduce hypersensitivity to light brush that develops after peripheral nerve injury (Fig 1 D).

B1_num_measures.evidence: The stimulation was repeated three times ... and the average scores was obtained for each mouse.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Across-day comparisons only; no within-session analysis.

D1_continuity.evidence: Brush-evoked dynamic hypersensitivity before (Bs) and after SNI surgery

D2_session_duration.evidence: The stimulation was repeated three times at intervals of at least 3min; total session duration not explicitly stated.

D3_recording_days.evidence: factor 'treatment' D14 to D45; D13 to D65 (number of test days inferred from ranges)

D5_followup.evidence: Testing through D45/D65, weeks after psilocybin injection.

water_restriction.evidence: No water in the testing chamber (standard apparatus).

assays.assay_description: Ugo Basile TPP apparatus: two cylinders connected by narrow walkway; after 5-min exploration at room temperature, one plate cooled to 15°C and time per chamber/transitions manually recorded over 10 min. Baseline and post-SNI testing after psilocybin 1 mg/kg (male mice).

application_type.evidence: single intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection of psilocybin (1 mg/kg) or saline control

setup_habituation.evidence: mice were initially allowed to explore the apparatus for 5 minutes with both plates at room temperature 23-25°C

setup_restrain.evidence: mice were initially allowed to explore the apparatus

food_restriction.evidence: No food in the TPP apparatus.

water_restriction.evidence: No water in the TPP apparatus.

time_to_assay.evidence: recorded the total amount of time mice spent on the cold plate before (Bs) and after nerve injury (day 1 to day 30); Bonferroni at D22 and D30

sample_size.evidence: (n= 5/5 mice, two-way repeated-measures mixed-model ANOVA, factor 'treatment' D13 to D30: F= 3.9, P=0.085)

assays.assay_description: Open-field arena (circular plastic box 33 x 33 cm) tracked with EthoVision XT; 10-min spontaneous behaviour sessions (distance, unsupported rearing, grooming) at 10 min and 3 days post-psilocybin in naïve mice (± volinanserin), 5-min OFT at 24 h post-injection (distance, centre entries), and distance after SNI vs after psilocybin ± volinanserin (Fig 1L).

application_type.evidence: Mice were tested 24 h post-injection with 1 mg/kg of psilocybin or saline vehicle; volinanserin (0.032mg/kg i.p.)

setup_habituation.evidence: Each animal was placed individually in the open-field arena; no prior apparatus habituation described.

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice were placed in the center of a circular plastic box (33 cm x 33 cm) and allowed to move freely.

time_to_assay.evidence: Unsupported rearing and grooming behaviours were reduced by psilocybin 10 minutes post-injection, but these changes were absent 3 days later ... Mice were tested 24 h post-injection

sample_size.evidence: Fig 1L: (n=6/6 mice); other open-field cohorts reported in Supplementary Figures 2 and 4

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (1 mg/kg), alone or with volinanserin, did not alter total distance travelled in naïve or SNI mice. Unsupported rearing and grooming were reduced 10 min post-injection but not 3 days later.
outcomes.evidence: No differences were observed in total distance travelled across groups ... Unsupported rearing and grooming behaviours were reduced by psilocybin 10 minutes post-injection, but these changes were absent 3 days later.

B1_num_measures.evidence: total distance travelled (cm) ... unsupported rearing and grooming episodes ... frequency of entering the center zone

B4_ethological.evidence: ethological parameters including unsupported rearing and grooming episodes were coded and analysed

B5_social.evidence: Each animal was placed individually in the open-field arena

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Spontaneous behaviour was assessed using the EthoVision XT video tracking system (SCORE-0 tool).

E3_bedding.evidence: circular plastic box; no bedding described

E7_social_context.evidence: Each animal was placed individually in the open-field arena

D1_continuity.evidence: 10 minutes post-injection ... 3 days later; 'After SNI' and 'After injection' sessions (Fig 1L)

D2_session_duration.evidence: recorded for the duration of the test session (10min); recorded over the next 5 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: 10 minutes post-injection ... 3 days later; 24 h post-injection

D5_followup.evidence: Mice were tested 24 h post-injection ... changes were absent 3 days later

judge_notes: Merged gemma4's separate 'Open Field Test' and 'Spontaneous behaviour' entries into one open-field assay (same arena/tracking, differing only in timepoint/session length), consistent with qwen and deepseek4.
Retained fecal pellet output as an assay (2/3 candidates) though it is arguably a physiological stress index; all B items scored 0.
Von Frey and brush B2 set to 0 (deepseek4): the 30 min–24 h time course comprises separate test sessions, i.e., between-session comparisons, not within-session dynamics.
TPP B1 set to 0: only time on cold plate is reported as a result; transitions were recorded but not reported. D2=0 because the scored test is 10 min (5-min pre-exploration had no data).
Rotarod: qwen's 24 h timing and 'setup_habituation=no' came from the OFT/baseline text, not rotarod; set to not_reported and D5=0.
Open field D4 overridden to Yes: Fig 1L reports distance travelled 'After SNI' (pre-injection) vs 'After injection'.
Day-count D3 values for brush, acetone and TPP cannot be verified from text (only day ranges given); chose modal/plausible bins with low confidence.

Added Gabapentin and Volinanserin dosing entries per rubric ('every drug compound administered'); psilocybin schedule kept 'acute' (modal; most experiments single dose), with the weekly x3 arm noted in evidence.
Gemma4's B1 point mismatches (score 1 for '1' measure; score 2 for '2-3') corrected to rubric points.
